entry_state: Chapter 13 closes by preserving raw occurrences, typed values, contextual comparison and optional reduced views. The Apple example connects actual source identities without inferring general validation or historical availability. Native Arelle and a deterministic PDF comparator are selected as source-grounded first paths; environment resolution, executed compatibility and distribution conditions remain separate. Acceptance criteria and sequencing follow next.
exit_state: Acceptance separates engineering conformance, accounting validity and scientific prediction. Exact cases and matched baselines have distinct evidence roles. E1 preserves complete disclosure content and E2 tests finite reconstruction soundness and completeness. E3 begins with a declared financial target and historical information boundary; its comparator and inference details continue next.
findings: The conformance cases include balanced but economically wrong counterexamples and preserve unknown solver outcomes.
The DSL comparison uses the same typed IR and equivalent documentation, while forecast comparisons use matched information and strong baselines.
The evaluation protocol treats exposed development data and unverified availability dates as limitations rather than heldout evidence. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
